titles.title: Nude No. VI

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Vertical watercolor of seated female nude on blue background.  Seated with legs hanging down one opens to the right.  Left and right arms  slightly away from body from chest. Face, arms and right leg fall into shadow.  Left side of torso is lighter, as if source of light comes from the left.  Nude No. VI. Possibly Self-Portraits etc. as noted in #176.
